meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

howto.what_en: Adds personal WeChat channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API using long-polling. After QR login, Claude can send and receive messages from your WeChat DMs and group chats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or integrate WeChat (e.g., "connect WeChat", "add WeChat channel") or request QR-code login.

say_en.text: Help me connect my personal WeChat
say_en.note: Runs the add-wechat install and configuration flow.

say_en.text: Let me scan the WeChat QR code
say_en.note: Reads the QR from logs or data/wechat/qr.txt for scanning.

say_en.text: Route WeChat messages to an agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to wire WeChat conversations to an agent group.
